# VIRYA

> Virya is a modern metalcore band from Poland. Heavy, melodic, bilingual EN/PL.
> All pages ship JSON-LD (MusicGroup, MusicEvent); this file orients AI assistants.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.virya.music/): tour dates with MusicEvent JSON-LD
- [News feed](https://www.virya.music/feed.json): machine-readable JSON feed
- [Music](https://www.virya.music/music): releases and lyrics
- [Videos](https://www.virya.music/videos): official videos
- [Merch](https://www.virya.music/merch): EU store, InPost shipping
- [Press kit](https://www.virya.music/epk): EPK and press photos
- [Gallery](https://www.virya.music/gallery): press-cleared photos
- [Contact](https://www.virya.music/join): booking and contact

## Notes

- Polish mirror lives under /pl with identical routes.
- Identity-free telemetry only; no cookies for analytics.
